english.title: Use sperm not partner donated to provide treatment/eggs after process or storage/other woman's eggs without licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the course of providing treatment services for a woman, namely **(..SPECIFY WOMAN..), used

(A)_[sperm other than partner-donated sperm which had been neither processed or stored,]_
(B)_[her eggs after processing]_
(C)_[her eggs after storage]_
(D)_[the eggs of another woman]_

other than in pursuance of a licence under Schedule 2 to the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to section 41(2)(ba) and (4) of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use in the course of providing treatment services
sperm after processing storage
in contravention of s 4(1)(b)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: No proceedings for an offence under this Act shall be instituted in England and Wales, except by or with the consent of the DPP or in Northern Ireland, except by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions for Northern Ireland.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
